title: Telerehabilitation in Patients with Respiratory Tract Diseases: Protocol for a Scoping Review
author: Shunsuke Taito
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf6wjrfe

steps.title: Define Research Questions
steps.instruction: Establish the primary research questions to guide the scoping review.

substeps.instruction: Define telerehabilitation for patients with respiratory tract disease.
Assess the safety of telerehabilitation for patients with respiratory tract disease.
Assess the feasibility of telerehabilitation for patients with COVID-19.

steps.title: Establish Inclusion and Exclusion Criteria
steps.instruction: Define the Population, Concept, and Context (PCC) framework for study selection.

substeps.instruction: Participants: Include patients with respiratory tract disease (ICD-10 codes J00-J99, A15-16, U04, U07.1, U07.2), including SARS-CoV, MERS-CoV, and COVID-19.
Concept: Review literature regarding rehabilitation programs, feasibility, and safety of telerehabilitation.

Context: Define telerehabilitation as delivery of therapeutic rehabilitation at a distance or offsite using telecommunication technologies (including terms 'remote rehabilitation' and 'virtual rehabilitation').
Settings: Include any setting (including hospital), any country, any phase, and any length of follow-up.

Study Types: Include randomized controlled trials, crossover trials, cluster-randomized trials, quasi-randomized trials, non-randomized trials, observational studies with control, case reports, and case series.
Exclusions: Exclude conference abstracts and review articles.

steps.title: Execute Literature Search
steps.instruction: Search electronic databases and trial registries using specific search strings.

substeps.instruction: Search MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), CINAHL, and PEDro using the specified keywords and MeSH terms for respiratory diseases and telerehabilitation.
Search the World Health Organization International Clinical Trials Registry Platform and ClinicalTrials.gov for ongoing trials.
Search references within identified articles for additional relevant studies.

steps.title: Select Studies
steps.instruction: Screen and select studies based on the PCC framework and PRISMA flow diagram.

substeps.instruction: Perform independent selection by two researchers (ST and KY).
Compare lists and resolve differences through discussion.
Use a third researcher (YK) for arbitration if discussion fails to resolve differences.

steps.title: Chart and Extract Data
steps.instruction: Extract relevant data from selected studies using standard forms.

substeps.instruction: Extract data by one researcher (ST) covering: diagnosis, setting, study type, number of participants, telerehabilitation program, control, outcomes, adverse events, and feasibility.
Verify extracted data through a second researcher (KY).
Contact original study authors if necessary for clarification.

steps.title: Collate and Report Results
steps.instruction: Synthesize the extracted data and present findings.

substeps.instruction: Present search results using the PRISMA flow diagram.
Organize data into qualitative synthesis tables.
Table 1: Include author, year, country, diagnosis, setting, study type, number of participants, telerehabilitation program (frequency, intensity, time, type), control, and outcomes.

Table 2: Include author, year, country, diagnosis, adverse events, withdrawals, adherence, face-to-face rehabilitation evaluation, face-to-face rehabilitation session, and ratio of telerehabilitation to all rehabilitation sessions.
